column1: # Hand-maintained list of specs outside patches/history/ that a later spec replaces, for tools/freespace.py.
# Their bytes are shown in the ledger as "superseded" and do not count as used or as an overlap.
# Columns (tab-separated): spec (path from the repo root), superseded by, evidence.

column3: description of v2: "v2 of interval-timelapse-insert-awake.json after two reviews"; v2 moved the code from the segment-3 tail to the segment-2 tail
insert-awake is the same spec plus the keep-awake hold (same segment-3 tail bytes)

log-card-look is probe 2 in place of probe 1 (log-card-read, camera-tested 2026-11-17): the same hook at the flush task entry, the same base, its T_CRD in the same run 0x7EBF2888 (experiments/2026-11-17-card-looks/NOTES.md)

log-card-probe is the probe harness in place of probe 2 (log-card-look, camera-tested 2026-11-17): the same hook and base, its T_CRD and T_HDR in the same runs 0x7EBF2888 and 0x7EBF2B90 (experiments/2026-11-17-card-looks/design.md section 8)

log-card-keep is the persistence probe after the probe harness (log-card-probe, flashed first): the same hook and base, its code in the same free runs of segment 2 (experiments/2026-11-17-card-looks/design.md section 8)

card-looks is the feature after the persistence probe (log-card-keep, camera-tested 2026-11-17): its code reuses the probe's free runs of segment 2; the two are never in one build (log-card-keep needs the debug log, card-looks is on films-12d) (experiments/2026-11-17-card-looks/design.md section 9.3)

films12cl-looks is films12-looks for the layout with twelve colour slots: the same five tables, Double-X (as a colour look) and Provia in the first two extra slots (experiments/2026-11-17-card-looks/design.md section 9.5); 24 of its 40 ops are equal to those of films12-looks

card-looks-2 is the card-looks loader for twelve colour slots with the menu row of looks-menu as its trigger: the same hook, task, code runs and data areas (experiments/2026-11-17-card-looks/design.md section 9.5)

card-looks-3 is the loader of card-looks-2 (flashed 2026-11-17, not accepted) with names, status, Built-in and live tables: the same hook, task, code runs and data areas (experiments/2026-11-17-card-looks/design.md section 10)
looks-menu-2 is looks-menu with a third item (Built-in) and a status text: the same row, list and data area (experiments/2026-11-17-card-looks/design.md section 10)

custom-menu-rows is peaking-menu with one more added row (Load Looks): the same list, texts and code, its item table one row longer at 0x7EBF1FF0 and its child list one entry longer at 0x7EBF2600 (experiments/2026-11-17-card-looks/design.md section 10.2)

looks-menu-3 is looks-menu-2 without the edit of the Touch Screen Settings row: Load Looks is an added row now (custom-menu-rows); the same list, texts and data area (experiments/2026-11-17-card-looks/design.md section 10.2)

card-looks-4 is card-looks-3 with its first run moved to 0x7EBF2890 (the longer child list of custom-menu-rows ends there): the same hook, task, code and data areas (experiments/2026-11-17-card-looks/design.md section 10.2)

custom-menu-rows-2 is custom-menu-rows with one more added row (Debug Log): the same operations, its item table one row longer at 0x7EBF1FF0, its child list one entry longer and moved to segment 3 data at 0x7EE3CBF4 (experiments/2026-11-18-log-menu/design.md)

log-menu is the log core (with an Off switch), the probes, the timing probe and the guard probe assembled again on the pinned build: the same code in the same kernel run 0x7E4C9514 and the segment-2 runs 0x7EBF2BE4 and 0x7EBF3780 (experiments/2026-11-18-log-menu/design.md)
as log-core: the probe routines are part of log-menu, in the same runs
as log-core: the timing probe's routines are part of log-menu, in the kernel run 0x7E4C9514
as log-core: T_GRD is part of log-menu, at 0x7EBF2600 (its old place 0x7EBF2510 is the longer item table of custom-menu-rows-2)

card-looks-5 is the loader of card-looks-4 for the stock-filters firmware: the same hook, task and code runs, without the snapshot, the live tables and Built-in, with the switch lists (experiments/2026-11-18-stock-filters/design.md)
looks-menu-4 is looks-menu-3 without Built-in: the same row, list and data area
the stock-filters firmware replaces the film firmware: stock-films-structure takes the place of the film specs, in their free runs (experiments/2026-11-18-stock-filters/design.md)
